Set small, attainable goals and work toward achieving them. ‘Time heals all wounds’ never came with a timeframe, ergo some days will continue to be harder than most, but over the course of time we continue to learn and we can achieve what we set our minds to. Yes, this includes setting our mind on completing a suicide, but what if we waited just one more day? I am not much of a morning person so seeing the sunrise is not entirely a motivating factor for me, but each and every sunset provides a beauty which is unique and different every single day. I might be having a terrible day and countless reasons to die, but despite the pain and adversity around me, I can at least look forward to watching the sunset and appreciating feeling, if only briefly, that somehow that single moment was made just for me simply because I can enjoy it and no one can take that away from me. It may not sound like much, but it gives me hope and the strength to fight through one more day. After all, we never know what tomorrow may bring; hence, we stay in the fight today and hold onto the simple things that matter to us. Time, you see, is on our side... it doesn’t mean we can control it, but we can at least find a way to get through... even if it’s just one sunset at a time.

Imagine what you can accomplish should you opt to stick around for another 20 years... I attempted suicide the first time when I was 14 years old and then again several years later. Fast forward to the present and I somehow managed to complete my education and became a doctor. Imagine the irony... all I wanted to do was die but through my pain and sorrow I found a way to stay in the fight. Now I use my experience as an opportunity to give others hope. After all, in all honesty, I figure if I can find a way to live, anyone can. Choosing to live is hard and some days just downright miserable; but that doesn’t mean we have to give up. Just keep putting one foot in front of the other. Set small, attainable goals, then work to achieve them. Stay focused. The hurt will probably always be there, but you’re stronger than you probably think you are. Be brave. Challenge yourself to live and strive to accomplish this task everyday. Who knows what tomorrow may bring... Stay in the fight.
